tools.name: search
tools.description: Search US court cases, attorneys and judges by name, case name or case number. Cases come from the latest 5 filing years unless year is set. Returns IDs for get_case, get_attorney and get_judge, and a report_url for each hit.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Public facts of one case: parties, attorneys, judge, status, disposition, the docket size with its latest 3 entries, a free link to the full record, and the case report offer.

tools.name: get_attorney
tools.description: An attorney's state, total cases and resolved cases, with the attorney report offer.

tools.name: get_judge
tools.description: A judge's state, court, total cases and resolved cases, with the judge report offer.

tools.name: get_court
tools.description: A court's name, state and address, with the court report offer.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
